subject: Data Engineering
title: Data Democratization
description: A micro-lesson that makes Data Democratization usable.

hook.text: Only three people in the company can access the data. Decisions wait weeks for their availability.

buildup.text: Data democratization makes data accessible to everyone who needs it, not just technical specialists.

discovery.text: Broad access combined with proper governance lets more people make data-informed decisions faster.

twist.text: Democratization without governance is chaos. Everyone has access, nobody knows what's trustworthy.

climax.text: The balance is wide access plus strong guardrails — like a library open to all with a good catalog.

punchline.text: Open the doors. But label the shelves.

quiz.question: What must accompany data democratization to be effective?
options: Unlimited admin access for all employees
